Assume WLOG \(x \le y\). Let \(a=y-x\ge 0\) and \(b=z-x\). Then

\[
1+n^a=n^b.
\]

So

\[
n^a(n^{b-a}-1)=1.
\]

Since \(n>1\), this forces \(a=0\). Then

\[
n^b-1=1 \implies n^b=2,
\]

so \(n=2,\ b=1\). Thus \(y=x\) and \(z=x+1\).

The condition \(n^z<2001\) becomes

\[
2^{x+1}<2001.
\]

Since \(2^{10}=1024<2001<2048=2^{11}\), we need \(x+1\le 10\), so \(x=1,2,\dots,9\).

Therefore, there are \(\boxed{9}\) solutions.
